title: Oscar and the Ledger
author: Rafael Okafor
blurb: Yara Villalobos, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
